Detailed Description

template<typename T>
class SoundGenerator< T >

Base class for all the generators.

Provides a common interface for the child objects, defining the general sampling rate and the virtual function tick ().

Member Function Documentation

template<typename T>
virtual T& SoundGenerator< T >::tick (  )  [pure virtual]

Pure virtual method that every child class MUST implement.

The output of this function should be the sample value specific to each class. No parameters are allowed.

Implemented in AbstractGranulator, CrossFade, Envelope, FMOscillator, GranularOscillator, Harmonizer, LoopOscillator, PitchShifter, PulseGenerator, UnitRandomNumberGenerator, RangedRandomNumberGenerator, SpectrumDesigner, TableGranulator, and Timeline.
